answer_1.quote: We present nCloze, an unsupervised, interpretable method for generating cloze tests based on these objectives.
answer_1.outputs: sets of distractors for cloze tests

answer_2.quote: We set α to maximize the Mean Reciprical Rank (MRR) of the CLOTH validation set ... We then optimize distractor sets for blanks in the CLOTH validation for β = {0.1, 0.3, 1, 3, 10} and compute F1 scores for retrieving the reference distractors.

answer_4.quote: We recruited 200 unique participants using Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) ...
answer_4.guideline: Participants took cloze tests generated by different systems; researchers measured validity (Pearson correlation with reference tests) and reliability (Spearman-Brown split-half correlation).
